summary: Biophytis SA filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the submission of a registration filing for its joint venture in Hong Kong with Ronghui Renhe Life Technology. The joint venture, Biophytis Biopharmaceutical Holding LTD, will receive a $20 million total committed financing with an initial $3 million payment from Asian partners, while Biophytis contributes patents and a license for BIO101 in Asia. The transaction is expected to close soon after registration, with operational launch immediately thereafter. This is an early-stage strategic move with no specific terms disclosed; watch for completion confirmation and partner contributions.
